summary: RETEST — Featured Image Phase 2 after single-line fix (StorageService.addAttachment → saveAttachment). Verified on live preview URL (https://color-task-timer.preview.emergentagent.com) with Playwright + real JPEG upload against a freshly-created note. VERDICT: PASS. Fix is in place at FeaturedImageBanner.jsx:76 and CACHE_NAME has been bumped to iron-rabbit-v175 (served & confirmed). All Phase 2 flows work end-to-end: chip-variant Add inside NoteModal, persist to IndexedDB, reopen shows hero variant in FullScreenNote, hero Change replaces attachment_id AND deletes the previous blob from filesStore (no orphans), hero Remove clears note.featured_image to null and restores the 'Add Featured Image' empty state. Zero TypeErrors, zero console errors during the entire flow. Title / content / category untouched throughout.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix at FeaturedImageBanner.jsx:76 is correct and minimal (single-line rename).

Blob-lifecycle handling in handleFile is correct: onChange fires with new attachment_id BEFORE deleting the old blob, so persistence writes happen first and old blob eviction is a best-effort tail call (wrapped in try/catch).
Both variants (hero + chip) share the same handleFile / handleRemove, so verifying either variant covers the shared logic.
SW CACHE_NAME v174→v175 correctly forces clients to fetch the corrected bundle; the update was activated on Preview.

One minor observation (non-blocking): FullScreenNote and NoteModal both mount FeaturedImageBanner but on different key flows (edit vs open-fullscreen). If a note is unsaved (no id yet) and the user tries chip Add, the disabled prop should be set. Current code allows Add before first save — verified working here because the modal-level state carries the featured_image into the save payload. No fix needed.
